titulo: Groggy at 7:01? The fog has a name.
caption:
Wake up groggy? That fog has a name: sleep inertia, the grogginess felt on waking. It fades the longer you're awake.
When my eyes open: feet on the floor. Sitting counts.
Source: Hilditch and McHill 2019, Nature and Science of Sleep. https://doi.org/10.2147/NSS.S188911
If standing up makes you dizzy, go slowly: lying, then sitting, then standing.
The tool is on the page: link in bio.
by NMR
